notes: Clock only: size-timing writes per-scenario wall-clock seconds per world, the projection to 2,000 worlds x 200 draws (plus the 3 x 500 power-run worlds) and the code / spec / design-text hashes; the worlds' return values are discarded unread and the output holds no rejection count, rate, p-value or status (8.4 step 3: no result of these runs is read beyond the clock). The seed 20261497 x 100 + 98 is neither the registered size-check seed (20261497) nor the development seed (x 100 + 99); the command refuses either. Worlds 3 / 3b use the labelled development q placeholder 0.20 while census_fixed.CH234.q_unknown is unfilled (timing only). Local planning: about 18 s for one world of every scenario (about 6 min for 20 worlds) on the Mac; the host is slower; timeout_s 7200. Run on the host-equivalent machine (the collection host), not beside any memory-heavy job. DRAFT, not in queue/jobs. Promote only after: the challenger review, the LT11 design-text freeze (LIVE_TESTS_11.md design text frozen at sha256 991100db5d6c75e3f76e3d0d10cc5f957dd755108e09ec05edd8dad0f91b3583), the LT11 code and the science-reviewer freeze check of the census and size-check code against LIVE_TESTS_11.md sections 1.4, 1.8, 1.8.1 and 7 (8.4 step 3), and never while E011's, LT2's or E015's analysis job, or an LT9 or LT10 census, size-check or analysis job, is running (memory-heavy-jobs rule). Counts 0 (descriptive; no trials line) except q0695, which writes the single counted trials line (kind live_tests11). Reads the DRAFT spec unpinned (except q0694 and q0695, which read the pinned spec); the code_sha256 of every hashed module is written into the output. Every gate threshold is stated in section 7 before this runs; nothing is re-tuned after it. Each census runs once; max_retries 1 covers a deterministic crash only (no output written). Runs with --data-dumps-cap-gb 40 where the runner accepts it (exit 75 above the cap).
